review_text: Muhammad delivered our mobile dashboard with a level of polish we didn't think was possible in such a tight timeframe. The codebase is clean, the performance is exceptional, and the UI is genuinely beautiful. Easily the best engineering hire we've made.

We brought Muhammad in for a critical refactor of our legacy app and he transformed it into a modern, maintainable codebase in record time. What impressed us most was his ability to balance speed with quality — we had zero regressions. Will absolutely work with him again.

The Flutter platform Muhammad built for us is our core product and it works flawlessly. He proactively suggested architectural improvements that saved us months of tech debt, and he communicated clearly throughout. His Firebase expertise is top-notch.

Truly rare to find someone who understands both product and engineering at this level. Muhammad asked exactly the right questions before writing code, which meant every feature shipped was exactly what we needed. Highly recommended.

Professional, fast, and genuinely cares about the outcome. Muhammad built our fitness app from scratch and delivered an experience that felt premium and native. His integration of biometrics and offline caching was flawless.
